scope: Complete ExperimentalSettings own public value/default/copy/equality/stream surface using public owned native fields and separately ported complete dependency values.
MSExperiment authoritative settings and typed metadata owner, clear/copy/processing preservation, bounded checked aggregate copies, explicit writer loss guards and loaded document provenance.
oracle: ExperimentalSettings_test.cpp supplies named default/copy/timestamp/HPLC/contact/configuration literals. Independent tests exercise every equality-significant field, negative zero/NaN/partial DateTime/stale Gradient, bounded copies and atomic native migration/transport behavior. No C++ executable was built and no expected scientific fixture was generated from Rust output. Existing mzML and processing fixtures are reused unchanged through their existing test targets.
native_boundaries: Public fields replace trivial C++ accessors; ordinary Clone/moves/PartialEq/Display replace value operations. Document path/type are copied but excluded from equality.

Checked aggregate copies use configurable count/work/bytes and a hard maximum sample depth of 64; ordinary Clone/equality/Drop remain ordinary Rust operations. Validation is resource-only and preserves stored nonfinite/negative scientific fields.
All run metadata now lives in settings.metadata: MetaInfo. Existing string-map API users must migrate explicitly; spectrum/chromatogram maps are unchanged.

Current mzML represents typed run scalar/unit metadata only. Lists, Empty, persistent identifier and every nondefault unrepresented header field fail before output. Full mzML header/consumer transport remains separate.
Run scalar validation/rendering/escaping precharges eight times measured settings work/bytes within the existing separate 50M/256MiB metadata allowance; binary budgets are unchanged.

Path loaders populate loaded path/type using the separately bounded DocumentIdentifier content detector; readers from streams leave those fields unset. Type detection separately reads at most 64KiB, independent of parse budgets.
MGF/MS2/DTA/DTA2D full experiment writers reject unsupported persistent settings. Explicit DTA2D TIC projection still ignores unconsumed settings.
Processing full-experiment clones charge settings through their existing shared AcquisitionCopies counters; source-compatible scalar semantics and numerical budgets remain unchanged.
